description: This Java class 'ShowcaseFragment' is part of an Android application. It manages a fragment that displays a help overlay with a sequence of steps guiding the user through UI elements. The class handles view highlighting, step management, scrolling, and user interactions during the tutorial process.

classes.name: ShowcaseFragment
classes.description: A Fragment class that displays a step-by-step help overlay for guiding user through UI elements in an Android app.

classes.name: ShowcaseFragment.Step
classes.description: Inner class representing a single step/page in the showcase tutorial, including text, target view references, and optional callback.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Initializes the adapter when the fragment is attached to a context.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates and configures the fragment's view hierarchy, including setting up the ViewPager and its adapter.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Performs setup tasks when the fragment becomes visible, such as obtaining display metrics and executing the initial step.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Performs cleanup tasks such as removing highlights and running the finish callback.

methods.name: setScroller
methods.description: Sets the ScrollView to control scrolling behavior.

methods.name: addStep (overloaded variants)
methods.description: Adds a new step to the tutorial sequence, with options for specifying text, target views, highlight views, and callbacks.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances to the next tutorial step.

methods.name: executeStep
methods.description: Displays the specified step, scrolls to target, and highlights the target view.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Removes the fragment from the activity, ending the tutorial.

methods.name: clearHighlight
methods.description: Removes any current view highlight and restores background states.

methods.name: highlightView
methods.description: Highlights a view by changing its background and elevation, and dulls the parent background.

methods.name: setOnFinish
methods.description: Sets a callback to be run when the showcase finishes.
